GOOD Items Logic
Get-AllStatuses detects current state of all 19 settings
Items already at recommended setting get Status containing "GOOD"
Auto-deselected before checklist display
Auto-skip during run (no Y/N prompt)
After run completes: "Want to change any GOOD items?" screen shows all skipped items with numbers
User types number to change; gets warning (no log notice repeat); logs as NOTED
BitLocker Dedicated Screen
ALWAYS last item after all 18 others complete
Detects: RAM (GB), drive size (GB), drive type (SSD vs HDD)
Calculates time estimate (low/medium/high severity)
Option 1: Enable now (wording adapts to severity)
Option 2: Enable overnight (wording adapts — "RECOMMENDED" for high severity)
Overnight instructions: Settings → System → Power & sleep → Screen: Never, Sleep: Never, plug in AC, restore settings in morning
Option 3: Skip with manual instructions + guide link
Battery check before enabling (requires AC power)
Recovery key saved to Desktop with hard pause for USB/print warning
Non-Recommended Warning
Triggers when SecurityCritical items deselected and not already GOOD
Shown at: checklist stage, review stage, final stage
Wording: "HEADS UP" (never "NOTICE" or "WARNING")
Options: Y = proceed (intentional), N = go back, S = see explanation of each item
Logs overrides as NOTED status (never WARN)
"For your protection, your choices can be reviewed in your log" — shown ONCE on review screen only, never repeated per item
